about.moneyP4: For travel, we dey get <1>referral commission</1> from booking partners, and you no go pay extra.

about.safetyP1: We <1>no dey ever publish</1> phone numbers for Market and Home Services. Una go exchange am only once seller or artisan accept your question — so nobody number go dey public page make person thief am, and you go only get the contact of person wey don agree to do business with you.
about.safetyP2: Na <1>Paystack</1> dey process payments. You go put card details for Paystack own safe checkout, and OAM no dey ever see or keep am.
about.noteBody: <1>Small talk about where we dey.</1> OAM just launch, so some places — especially the Market and the artisan list — still dey fill up. E go dey grow as more people join, and we prefer to talk am than to pretend.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Something spoil, or you get question before you start? See how you fit reach person.
contact.emailBody: The fastest way for anything about payment, token wey no come, or account wahala.
contact.paymentP1: <1>Abeg no pay two times.</1> If order show "processing", the money don already comot and the purchase dey with your provider — if you buy again, you fit pay for the same thing two times.
contact.paymentLi1: the <1>reference number</1> for the order (e dey start with BILL-, FUND- or TRF-)
contact.paymentLi2: the email address for your OAM account
contact.paymentP2: That one dey usually enough make we find the transaction and tell you exactly where e dey. You fit find the reference for <1>Order history</1>.
contact.mktTitle: To buy or sell for the Market
contact.mktP1: Questions about one item or work, e better make you ask <1>straight for the chat</1> wey dey that listing or artisan profile — the other person go get notification, and record go dey of wetin una agree.
contact.mktP2: Contact us instead if person ask you to pay outside OAM, dey force you to pay money first, or dey behave anyhow. We prefer to hear am early.
contact.responseBody: We dey try reply every email within <1>one working day</1>. We dey look payment wahala first. If you never hear from us after two working days, reply your own email make e show up again — e work pass to send new one.
contact.scamBody: <1>We no go ever ask for your password, card PIN, or one-time code.</1> Anybody wey ask — by call, SMS or WhatsApp — no be from OAM, no matter how sweet their mouth be. Drop the call and email us instead.
contact.phoneBody: Dey available for working hours for urgent matters. Email dey fast pass for payment and account wahala.
contact.addressBody: Our registered office. Abeg email or call before you come.
contact.thanks: Thank you — your message don ready to send from your email app. We go reply as soon as we fit.

help.title: Help centre
help.intro: Answers to the things wey people dey ask pass — starting with the one wey matter when money dey involved.
help.noMatch: Nothing match "{{query}}". Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> and person go answer you.

electricity.title: Light tokens
electricity.q1: I pay for units but token no show. Wetin I go do?
electricity.a1p1: <1>No buy again.</1> Your payment don go and the order dey with your provider — if you buy again, dem go charge you two times for the same meter.
electricity.a1p2: Open <1>Order history</1>. As the order still dey finish, you go see "Token dey come", and the page dey check with your provider every few seconds. Tokens dey usually land within one or two minutes, sometimes e dey take long for busy time.
electricity.a1p3: We go also email you the token as soon as dem release am, so you go get am even if you don close the app.
electricity.q2: Where I fit find old token?
electricity.a2: Every token dey saved forever for <1>Order history</1> — open the order and e dey there with copy button. E also dey the receipt email wey we send that time.
electricity.q3: Dem no accept the meter number.
electricity.a3: Naija prepaid meters get <1>11 digits</1>. We dey check with your disco only once all 11 enter, so if message show as you still dey type, e mean say we dey wait. If complete number still no work, check say you pick the correct disco — correct meter for wrong disco no go ever work.

wallet.title: Wallet and payments
wallet.q1: Why my card payment dey enter my wallet first?
wallet.a1p1: Card payments dey enter your wallet, then the wallet go pay for wetin you buy. E be like extra step, but na on purpose.
wallet.a1p2: If delivery no work, the money don already dey safe for your wallet as balance wey you fit spend or withdraw. If we pay provider straight, your money fit hang between the card company and dem, with no clean way back.
wallet.a2: No. The total wey we show before you pay na wetin you go pay — the fee line dey show ₦0 because no fee dey. Our gain dey inside the price of bills, so we no dey add anything for checkout.
wallet.a3: Bank transfers dey usually land within minutes, but e fit take long when bank network dey down. If withdrawal no work, the money go return to your wallet by itself — e no lost, and you fit try again.
wallet.q4: I fit send money to another OAM user?
wallet.a4: Yes — <1>Transfer</1> dey move money between OAM wallets sharp sharp and free. Put their email or phone number and their name go show before you confirm. <2>Check that name well well</2>: transfer wey don finish no fit reverse.

marketplace.title: Market and artisans
marketplace.q1: Why I no fit see seller phone number?
marketplace.a1p1: We no dey ever publish numbers. Send message about the item, and once the seller accept, una go see each other contact details.
marketplace.a1p2: E slow small, but na the best protection wey we fit give: numbers wey dey public dey get scraped, and scraped numbers dey used for fake-person scam.
marketplace.q2: How many things I fit list for free?
marketplace.a2: Three active listings, forever, you no need card. Premium (₦2,500) go give you reach 20 listings plus featured spot, and Pro (₦5,000) no get limit.
marketplace.q3: How I go take dey safe when I dey buy and sell?
marketplace.a3li1: Meet for open place for afternoon
marketplace.a3li2: Check the item before any money change hand
marketplace.a3li3: No ever send money first to person wey you never meet
marketplace.a3li4: Make the chat remain for OAM, so record go dey of wetin una agree
marketplace.a3li5: If person say make una move go WhatsApp "for better price", take am as warning sign
marketplace.q4: Wetin boost artisan profile dey do?
marketplace.a4: E dey put your profile above the ones wey no boost for search results, where most people dey look. Premium na ₦2,500 for 30 days and Pro na ₦5,000 for 90. Both na <1>one-time payments</1> — nothing go renew by itself.

account.title: Account
account.q1: I fit use the same account to buy and to sell?
account.a1: Yes. One account dey do everything — you fit sell fridge and hire plumber for the same week. Your messages dey split into "Wetin I don ask" and "Wetin people ask me" so the two no go tangle.
account.a2: No. You go put card details for Paystack safe checkout, and we no dey ever see or keep am.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Wetin we dey collect, why, who else dey see am, and wetin you fit ask us to do about am.
privacy.controlBody: <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1> (RC <2>8034525</2>) na the data controller. For any privacy question or request, email <3>oamapp26@gmail.com</3>.
privacy.giveLi1: Name, email address and phone number when you register
privacy.giveLi2: Bank account details when you set up withdrawal
privacy.giveLi3: Meter numbers, smartcard numbers and phone numbers wey you dey pay bills for
privacy.giveLi4: Listing details, artisan profile details, and the contact numbers wey dey there
privacy.giveLi5: Messages wey you send to other users through OAM
privacy.collectCreated: Wetin dey come as you dey use OAM:

privacy.createdLi2: Orders, references, and light tokens wey dem give you
privacy.createdLi3: Around where you dey, if you allow am, to find artisans wey dey near you
privacy.collectCard: <1>We no dey ever see or keep your card details.</1> You dey put card for Paystack own checkout and e dey remain with dem.
privacy.whyLi1: <1>To run your account and process payments</1> — we no fit deliver airtime or units without the number or meter
privacy.whyLi2: <1>To send receipts and tokens</1> by email, so token wey don land no go lost when you close the app
privacy.whyLi3: <1>To connect buyers and sellers</1> — we dey release contact details only when dem accept question
privacy.whyLi4: <1>To stop fraud</1> and check bad use
privacy.whyLi5: <1>To follow law and regulator rules</1>, including keeping money records
privacy.whyNoSell: We <1>no dey</1> sell your personal data, and we no dey show advert based on am.
privacy.whoIntro: Na only wetin each partner need to do their work:
privacy.whoLi1: <1>Paystack</1> — payments and withdrawals; dem go get your name, email and payment details
privacy.whoLi2: <1>Bill providers</1> — the phone number, meter or smartcard number for that purchase
privacy.whoLi3: <1>Other OAM users</1> — your name and, once you accept question, your contact number
privacy.whoLi4: <1>Travel partners</1> — if you follow booking link, their own privacy policy go apply from there
privacy.whoLi5: <1>Regulators or police</1> — where law say we must show am
privacy.contactTitle: Contact details for listings and profiles
privacy.contactP1: The number for your listing or artisan profile <1>no dey public</1>. We dey keep am private and release am to one person only when you accept their question.
privacy.contactP2: We do am on purpose: numbers wey dey public pages dey get harvested and used for fake-person scam. Make the release dey your hand na the best protection wey we fit give, so we build am inside the product, no be setting.
privacy.keepTitle: How long we dey keep am
privacy.keepP1: We dey keep account and transaction records as long as your account dey open, and for some time after to follow money record rules.
privacy.keepP2: We dey keep messages between users as long as both accounts dey open.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 you fit ask us to:
privacy.rightsLi1: show you the personal data wey we get about you
privacy.rightsLi3: delete data wey we no get legal reason to keep again
privacy.rightsLi4: stop to use your data for one particular reason
privacy.rightsLi5: give you your data for form wey you fit carry go
privacy.rightsEmail: Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1>. We go reply within one month.
privacy.rightsKeep: Some data we must keep even after you ask — like money transactions wey don finish, where law say record must dey. We go tell you if e concern you.
privacy.securityP1: We dey keep passwords hashed, never for form wey person fit read. Payments dey pass through Paystack safe checkout. Na only the people wey need am to run the service fit see customer data inside OAM.
privacy.securityP2: No system dey perfectly safe. If breach touch your data, we go tell you and the regulator as law talk.
privacy.changesBody: If we change this policy for big way, we go tell you by email or inside the app before e start. See also our <1>Terms of Service</1>.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The agreement between you and O.A.M Motors Limited when you dey use OAM.
terms.s1Body: Na <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1> dey run OAM, company wey register for Naija (RC <2>8034525</2>), registered address <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. For these terms "we", "us" and "OAM" mean that company; "you" mean the person wey get the account.
terms.s2P1: You must be <1>18 or more</1> and give correct details. One person, one account. Na you go keep your password and one-time codes private — we no go ever ask you for dem, and anybody wey ask no be from OAM.
terms.s2P2: Tell us quick quick for <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> if you think say another person dey enter your account.
terms.s3P1: Your wallet balance na money wey we dey hold for you. E no be bank deposit, e no dey get interest, and deposit insurance no cover am.
terms.s3P2: You fit withdraw your balance go bank account for your own name anytime, but e go pass the checks for down. Card payments dey enter your wallet first, then the wallet go pay for wetin you buy — so if delivery no work, the money still be your own as wallet balance.
terms.s3P3: <1>Transfer between OAM users no dey reverse.</1> Check the person name wey we show before you confirm, because transfer wey don finish no fit come back.
terms.s4P1: We dey buy these ones from licensed providers when you instruct us. The price wey we show you na the price wey you go pay; our gain dey inside am and we no dey add separate fee.
terms.s4P2: <1>Check the person before you confirm.</1> Airtime wey you send to wrong number, or units wey go wrong meter, no dey usually come back — the value don already land for that number or meter.
terms.s4P3: If purchase no work for provider side, the money go return to your wallet. If provider delay, the order go remain open until e settle; if you buy again during the delay, you go pay two times, and we no fit refund double purchase wey you choose to make.
terms.s5P1: <1>OAM no be part of these deals.</1> We dey provide the listing and the chat; the agreement na between buyer and seller, or customer and artisan. We no dey check items, check work, hold payment for escrow, or promise quality.
terms.s5P2: Na you get wetin you post, and you must do your own side of anything wey you agree. Una go exchange contact details only when seller or artisan accept question.
terms.s5ListIntro: You no fit post, among other things:
terms.s5Li1: anything wey e illegal to sell for Naija
terms.s5Li2: weapons, drugs wey government control, or fake goods
terms.s5Li3: stolen things, or anything wey you no get right to sell
terms.s5Li4: services wey you no get qualification or licence to do
terms.s5P3: We fit remove listings and suspend accounts if person break these terms. Money for paid plan no dey usually refund if we suspend account because of breach.
terms.s6P1: Seller subscriptions (Premium and Pro) and artisan boosts na <1>one-time payments</1> for the time wey we talk. Dem no dey renew by themselves, and we no dey keep card for future charges.
terms.s6P2: Featured spot dey make you show better for search. E no promise sales, questions, or any level of interest.
terms.s6P3: Prices fit change; any change go apply to new purchases, no be to time wey you don pay for already.
terms.s7Body: Flights, hotels, car hire and airport transfers dey booked with <1>other partners</1>, for their sites and under their terms. Your contract for those bookings na with dem, no be with OAM. We dey get referral commission and you no go pay extra.
terms.s8Title: 8. Things wey we no fit promise
terms.s8P1: We dey work make OAM dey available and correct, but we depend on banks, card companies and utility providers wey their systems dey sometimes fail. We no promise say service no go ever stop.
terms.s8P2: Nothing here dey limit our liability for fraud, or for anything wey Naija law no allow make we limit.
terms.s9P1: You fit close your account anytime; withdraw your balance first, because we fit need to check your identity before we release money.
terms.s9P2: We fit suspend or close account if we get correct reason to suspect fraud, illegal use, or serious breach of these terms. If we do am, we go return any balance wey be your own, except law no allow am.
terms.s10P1: We fit update these terms. We go tell you about big changes by email or inside the app before dem start.
terms.s10P2: Na the laws of <1>Federal Republic of Nigeria</1> dey govern these terms. Abeg contact us first — most wahala dey settle quick by email.
terms.s7P1: Flights, hotels, car hire and airport transfers dey booked with other travel partners. Your booking contract na with that partner and e dey under their terms, prices and cancellation rules — OAM dey help you find and reach dem, but OAM no be the travel provider.
terms.s11P1: Na the laws of Federal Republic of Nigeria dey govern these terms, and any dispute go dey under only Naija courts.
terms.s12P1: Questions about these terms? Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> and we go get back to you.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: How refund dey work for OAM, and wetin to do if transaction get wahala.
refund.s1P1: This policy cover payments wey you make for OAM — wallet funding, airtime and data, light and cable, transfers, bus tickets, betting top-ups and other services. Purchases wey you finish for partner own website or app (like travel bookings and e-commerce stores) dey under that partner refund terms, no be this policy.
refund.s2P1: Bills, airtime, data, tokens, top-ups and similar services dey land sharp sharp and we no dey usually refund am once the value don land for the number, meter or account wey you give.
refund.s2P2: Always check the person details again before you pay. Value wey land for wrong-but-correct number or meter wey you put, OAM no fit bring am back.
refund.s3Title: 3. Transactions wey no work or no finish
refund.s3P1: If dem remove money from your wallet or card but the service no land, the money go return to your OAM wallet by itself, usually within minutes.
refund.s3P2: If the money never return after 24 hours, contact us with the transaction reference and we go check and settle am.
refund.s4P1: Money wey you put for your OAM wallet dey as your balance and you fit use am for the app or withdraw go your own Naija bank account.
refund.s4P2: If your bank charge you for funding but e no show for your wallet, e go return by itself once the payment company settle; if e no return, contact us and we go settle am.
refund.s5P1: If dem charge you more than one time for the same order, or payment clearly fail for provider side, we go refund the extra charge to your wallet after we check am.
refund.s5P2: We dey refund to your OAM wallet normally. Where refund to your bank card or account dey required, e go follow the payment company timeline.
refund.s6P1: OAM dey connect buyers and sellers and help you find artisans, but OAM no be part of those deals. Payments wey you make straight to another user, seller or service provider na between you and dem; OAM no dey refund such payments, but we go help where we fit.
refund.s7P1: To ask for refund or report transaction wahala, email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> with your registered email or phone, the transaction reference, the date and amount, and short description. Our team go check am and reply as fast as possible.
refund.s8P1: We fit update this Refund Policy from time to time. The date for top dey show when we change am last, and if you continue to use OAM, e mean say you accept the current version.

deletePage.title: Delete your OAM account
deletePage.intro: You fit delete your OAM account anytime, from the app or by email.
deletePage.inApp1: Open the OAM app and enter.
deletePage.inApp2: Go to Profile and tap “Delete account”.
deletePage.inApp3: Confirm with your password (or type DELETE if you dey enter with Google or Apple).
deletePage.emailBody: If you no fit use the app, email <1>info@oam-app.com</1> from the email wey dey your account with subject “Delete my OAM account”. We go confirm say na you, then delete the account.
deletePage.deletedBody: Your name, email address, phone number, transaction PIN, saved devices and Google or Apple sign-in wey you link. Your market listings, artisan profile, CV and job posts go comot, and you no go fit enter again.
deletePage.keptTitle: Wetin we go keep, and why
deletePage.keptBody: We go keep records of payments, wallet transactions, withdrawals and deliveries without your name for at least 5 years after we delete the account, because anti-money-laundering rules and fraud prevention say we must keep dem. All other data go delete sharp sharp.
deletePage.before: Before you delete, withdraw any money wey remain for your wallet and finish any delivery wey dey go on — the app go remind you if anything still dey pending.
